name: Filesystem Semantic Search
description: Searches files with regex and then filters matching text semantically with Jev.

commands.title: Search files semantically
commands.description: Use this command when the user asks to find relevant content inside files. Input must be an object with: folder (absolute folder path), query (natural-language description of what the agent is looking for), patterns (a non-empty array of JavaScript regular-expression strings used only to generate search candidates), extensions (a non-empty array of file extensions such as ['.txt', '.md']), optional threshold (a number from 0 to 1, default 0.6), and optional batch_size (an integer from 1 to 32, default 32). Example: {"folder":"E:\\news","query":"Find English text about stocks","patterns":[".*[sS][tT][oO][cC][kK].*"],"extensions":[".txt"],"threshold":0.6}. Use broad regex patterns for candidate generation and use query for semantic relevance. Do not put the entire natural-language request directly into patterns. The command returns only passages judged relevant by Jev, including file path, file name, text, line range, and relevance score.
